title: Mistral's 'State-of-the-Art' Claim vs Its Own Page

beats.label: THE CLAIM
beats.line: Mistral calls Mistral Large 4 {q1}. Check what its own page says next.

beats.label: EVIDENCE: CYBER INDEX
beats.line: On the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index, the page says it {q1}.
quotes: leads open-weight models developed outside China

beats.label: EVIDENCE: QUALIFIERS
beats.line: Overall, the page says it is {q1}. In finance, it is {q2}.
quotes: competitive with the strongest open-source models globally
on par or close to GLM-5.3

beats.label: THIRD-PARTY CHECK
beats.line: Fair point: on legal and financial tasks, a third-party evaluation finds it {q1}.

beats.label: VERDICT
beats.line: Our reading: partly supported, because the page qualifies its own claim. The headline or the qualifiers: which do you trust?
